description: Rather than styling ourselves as the equal of other dukes, we instead choose to be elevated to a status that better expresses our strength.

name: Sich Rada
description: Wishing to further organize the [ShowEstateTypeName('cossacks_estate')] under one ruler, the $cossacks_reform$ places a Hetman in charge to lead them all, serving either their own interests or the interests of their liege.

name: Bank of $ENG$
description: A centralized and influential institution, this bank is made up of powerful financiers and greatly increases our credibility and capacity to handle our debts. Its purpose is to handle public finances, helping to stabilize government borrowing.

name: Mandate of the Commons
description: Many [ShowCultureGroupName('chinese_group')] dynasties have been founded with the support of the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')]. However, only ours has fully recognized the importance of the common people. No other era in the history of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('middle_kingdom').GetName] has ever seen such popular support!

name: Royal Council of Castile
description: The $royal_council_of_castile$ is a centralized royal council to streamline taxation, justice, and administration under the direct oversight of the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')].

name: Nueva Planta
description: The $nueva_planta$ is a series of decrees and reforms formalized in order to abolish regional legal privileges and forge a single, unitary state under central authority.

name: Royal Factories
description: Royal Factories are state-funded manufactories directly overseen by the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')] to produce strategic and luxury goods in support of mercantilist and centralized economic policies.

name: Intendancy System
description: The $intendancy_system$ is a new system of governance aimed at centralizing the authority of the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')] over that of the bureaucrats in order to oversee tax collection and implement anti-corruption measures.

name: Great Law of Peace
description: Enshrined through Wampum belts, the framework for the Great Law of Peace has governed our Confederacy since its inception. Emphasizing peace and justice, along with maintaining a steady mind, the principles of the Great Law of Peace have united all within the [ShowCultureGroupName('haudenosaunee_group')] nation.

name: The Grand Council
description: Comprised of fifty chiefs from each of the Five Nations, the [ShowCultureGroupName('haudenosaunee_group')] Grand Council carries out the principles of the Great Law of Peace. The council's governance requires all fifty chiefs to reach a unified consensus before affairs can continue.

name: Peuplierung System
description: The $peuplierung_system$ is an initiative that aims to attract immigrants to settle in the sparsely populated regions of the nation.

name: $guru_granth_sahib$
description: $guru_granth_sahib_desc$

name: Alsnö Stadga
description: This set of rules was set up by [GetCharacter('swe_magnus_ladulas').GetName] in 1280 at Alsnö Hus to regulate and formalize the benefits of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], while also protecting the [ShowPopTypeName('peasants')] from their exploits. This is why he was nicknamed 'Ladulås', or 'Barn-Lock' in English by the commoners.

name: Shāhbandariyya
description: $shahbandar_desc$

name: Partitio Terrarum Imperii Romaniae
description: After the Fourth Crusade, the Eastern Roman Empire was partitioned among several Western European families, who then founded a series of Crusader Principalities. While these polities existed, they were a constant threat to the Empire.

name: Titular Rulers of the Latin Empire
description: Although we have since lost control of [ShowLocationName('constantinople')], the seat of power for the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongName], our claim to it still remains as strong as ever.

name: Dominance of the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('catalan')] Company
description: Since the seizure of the [GetCountry('ATH').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip], the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('catalan')] Company has projected considerable military influence over [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')].

name: [GetCountry('PAP').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] Backing to Retake [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('constantinople')]
description: Although the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongName] has since been destroyed by the [GetCountry('BYZ').GetLongName], recent crusader state campaigns in [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')] have encouraged [GetCountry('PAP').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] sponsorship to restore the empire.

name: Restored Rule of the Latins
description: Once thought to be lost forever to a resurgent [GetCountry('BYZ').GetName], the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip] has at long last been restored in [ShowLocationName('constantinople')], and once against serves as a bastion of [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] rule throughout [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')].

name: Libertas!
description: The common people should not wait until foreign powers come and take away their homes, families, and futures. Instead, every citizen must be ready to give up their lives for a brighter future.

name: Autocracy
description: Autocratic monarchies concentrate power in the hands of the ruler. The state is often seen as their personal property. It is not uncommon for rulers to have ministers and supporters, but these are then referred to as members of the royal household.

name: Feudal Nobility
description: In a feudal kingdom, the power of the monarch is enhanced by a land-owning aristocracy sworn to obey them. The aristocrats, or [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] , are often landowners in their own right, with considerable influence and vassals of their own.

name: Margraviate
description: A [ShowGovernmentReformName('margraviate')] is a historical territorial jurisdiction, named after a #italic Markgraf#!, or 'count on the frontier', who serves to defend and administer the border regions of a realm, mostly focused on repelling external threats. Margraviates blend military defense with governance; the Margrave's responsibilities include safeguarding the frontier and managing local affairs, bridging the gap between the central authority and these border territories.

name: Landgraviate
description: A [ShowGovernmentReformName('landgraviate')], named after a #italic Landgraf#!, acts as an immediate jurisdiction of the [GetInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] in otherwise fractured counties. The Landgrave is a direct representative of the law of the [GetInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle] in the lands of the [ShowGovernmentReformNameWithNoTooltip('landgraviate')], and the title is comparable to a Duke in power and responsibilities.

name: Of Noble Bearing
description: The proud lineage of our nobles, standing far taller on two legs than the rulers of any other nation on Earth, should be evident to all!

name: Judicate
description: The Judicate is a unique type of government which is defined by its republic-like institutions, and by electing the ruler from within the Supreme Court.

name: The Court of Wards and Liveries
description: With a court of wards and liveries, the administration of tax collection and feudal dues is much more effective, due to increased expertise among collectors and a systemized revenue system. However, the nobility tend to consider such courts deeply exploitative of their own fortunes.

name: Royal Decree
description: The monarch rules supreme in this country, and loyalty is valued above all else. We must ensure that decrees from the royal court are followed to the letter, and in all parts of our country.

name: Privy Council
description: Staying informed about events within one's domain is vital for any ruler. By establishing a privy council, we will be able to keep a much closer eye on our people.

name: Royal Commissions
description: Investigating suspicious behavior within the administration might be a good idea from time to time. Creating more royal commissions will certainly help to reduce corruption.

name: Revolutionary Empire
description: The $revolutionary_empire$ is a $monarchy$ which makes some concessions to the ideas of the [ShowInstitutionName('enlightenment')], while ruling over the people with absolute power under the pretext of serving revolutionary ideals.

name: Feudal Theocracy
description: A $feudal_theocracy$ is a state ruled by a religious figurehead. Unlike other theocracies, it is governed in a more hereditary manner, allowing its rulers to pass the leadership to members of their families.

name: Noble Elite
description: In this republic, the right to rule is hereditary within certain noble dynasties. These families elect the ruler from within their dynasty, and this head of government will in turn depend on their support.

name: Sortition
description: Unfortunately, votes can be bought, and old loyalties may cloud the judgment of some electors. Let us implement a semi-randomized system where names can be chosen from a pool of good candidates for important offices.

name: Merchant Republic
description: A republic founded upon the principles of trade. The flow of commerce is the most important factor for the families who rule these republics.

name: Peasant Republic
description: A form of government in which the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')], [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], and [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] are very weak or non-existent, granting a high degree of autonomy to the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')].

name: Pirate Brethren
description: Insofar as this loose collection of pirate crews can be called a state, the $pirate_brethren_reform$ is a haven for all manner of thieves, murderers, and smugglers.

name: Formalized Scales, Weights, and Measures
description: Our nation has formalized its system of scales, weights, and measures. While it is not universal, the new system does ensure our people use the same basic units of measurement everywhere in the country. Now, there are four bovates to a hide. Or possibly eight. And then five hides equal a fee... er, or do they?

name: Dynastic Signoria
description: Individual city-states ruled by powerful families, the $dynastic_signoria_reform$ involves a concentration of power in a small group of influential individuals known as the #italic signori#!. These individuals, some who were of merchant or banking origins rather than traditional nobility, hold both executive and legislative authority, effectively monopolizing control over their respective cities. They aim to maintain their power at all costs, often resulting in bloody feuds and conflicts between and within houses as they struggle for supremacy.

name: Signoria
description: A specific [ShowCultureGroupName('italian_group')] form of city republican government. Members are elected for a specific period of time, usually from among the most influential citizens of that city. However, in many cases they are also foreign rulers who are invited to rule the $signoria_reform$.

name: Revolutionary Republic
description: The $revolutionary_republic$ governs the nation through a small executive authority, supported by an elective chamber of deputies. Revolutionary propaganda will strengthen the resolve of our armies, and the principal of universal equality should inspire strong and confident leadership.

name: Revolutionary Autocracy
description: While on the surface a $republic$, the $revolutionary_autocracy$ is akin to an absolute $military_dictatorship$ led by a competent general or admiral who enjoys great popularity amongst the masses.

name: Hanseatic Merchant Federation
description: This represents a decentralized federation of merchants united under one alliance. Its members occupy special buildings across the entirety of [ShowContinentName('europe')] and are known for their mercantile prowess.

name: Legacy of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$
description: We are the descendants of the great conqueror of the world, $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$. His blood runs through our veins, making us a proud and powerful people, and promising us that everywhere our horses can take us shall be ours to conquer!

name: Military Order
description: The Military Orders were created in the Middle Ages as a militant body of the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] Church. They are made up of warriors, named #italic miles#!, as well as monks called #italic fratres#! who have taken solemn religious vows to defend and spread the [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] faith.

name: Abbey
description: Abbeys have been centers of monastic life since the earliest [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] times. Over the centuries, they have become the main foci of religious life, knowledge, and education, as well as centers of economic and social development.

name: Legatus Natus
description: We are the Pope's representative north of the Alps!

name: Primas Germaniae
description: We hold the prestigious title of Primas Germaniae, distinguishing us as one of the most important ecclesiastical offices in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Prince Bishopric
description: A Prince-Bishop is an ordained member of a faith who is also the civil ruler of a territory. The religious territory that the Prince-Bishops rules over does not need to coincide with the secular territory they own.

name: $guru$ Leadership
description: The country is led by a wise $guru$, tending to the spiritual needs of the populace as well as more mundane matters and guiding the faithful to enlightenment.
